name: Plex Media Server
description: Popular media server (free account needed for some features).
compose:
services:
  plex:
    image: plexinc/pms-docker:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./transcode:/transcode
      - ${SHARE:video}:/data/video:ro
      - ${SHARE:music}:/data/music:ro
